name: dsh-thinking-phrase
description: Customize the running thinking label ("Deep diving for …"): nine effects (typewriter, command line, wipe, focus, decode, scroll and more), placeholders for seconds, a spinner and a progress bar, random phrases, a random effect per phrase, and an optional typo that corrects itself. | 自定义会话进行中的「深度求索中，用时 …」提示文字：九种特效（打字机、命令行、揭幕、对焦、解码、平移等）、秒数/转动标记/进度条占位符、随机短语、随机效果、偶发错字自动修正。
